name: emil-plugins
description: Emil's Claude Code plugins and mods

plugins.name: readable
plugins.description: Styled replies and prompts (Embark or glamour dark), with solid panels for code, quotes, prompts and pastes

plugins.name: gh-account
plugins.description: Runs gh and git network commands as the GitHub account for their directory or org, with no gh auth switch

plugins.name: pr-card
plugins.description: A PR card under git push and gh pr commands (commit graph, merge state and conflicts, CI checks), and the PR's status above the prompt
